paper_title: On the Parameterized Complexity of Red-Blue Points Separation
statement: The most intriguing open problem is settling the complexity of Axis-Parallel Red-Blue Separation w.r.t. the number of lines. We conjecture it to be FPT. Other problems include the complexity of Red-Blue Separation when the lines can have three different slopes and of Axis-Parallel Red-Blue Separation in 3-dimensions.
